rows.grounds: noun siddhayaḥ (accomplishments/siddhis); form kept as given (surface shows siddhayo).
numeral aṣṭau (eight); elided form written as 'ṣṭau kept exactly as given.
genitive plural demonstrative teṣām (of them); kept as given.
compound dhana+dhānyā+di+sūnavaḥ (wealth + grain + etc. + sons/offspring); fused form kept as one token.
